description_en: Batch authorization of BI portal menu will be skipped automatically
description_zh: 数据门户菜单的批量授权，已经授权的会自动略过
name: AuthorizeMenu

parameters.help_en: The ID of the BI portal
parameters.name: data_portal_id

parameters.help_en:
The menu ID of the BI portal leaf node.

The directory menu cannot be authorized.
You can upload multiple parameters at a time. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). The maximum number of parameters that can be modified at a time is 100
parameters.help_zh:
数据门户的叶子节点菜单ID。
支持批量传参，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开，批量修改的最大数为100
parameters.name: menu_ids

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the user groups.

You can upload multiple parameters at a time. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). The maximum number of parameters that can be modified at a time is 200.
UserGroupIds and UserIds cannot be empty at the same time
parameters.help_zh:
用户组ID列表。

支持批量传参，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开，批量修改的最大数为200
UserGroupIds和UserIds不能同时为空
parameters.name: user_group_ids

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the end users. The UserID of the Quick BI is used instead of the UID of Alibaba Cloud.

You can upload multiple parameters at a time. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). The maximum number of parameters that can be modified at a time is 200
parameters.help_zh:
用户ID列表。此处为Quick BI的UserID，而非阿里云的UID。

支持批量传参，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开，批量修改的最大数为200
parameters.name: user_ids

parameters.help_en:
Authorizes the permissions of the menu. Valid values:

1: view
3: View + Export (default)
parameters.help_zh:
授权菜单的权限。取值范围：

1：查看
3：查看+导出（默认）
parameters.name: auth_points_value

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
是否请求成功。取值范围：

true：请求成功
false：请求失败
